# On a new family of exact solutions to the wave equation in a compressible material

 Abstract In this paper we provide rigorous and exact solutions to an initially static infinite string, immersed into an isotropic and homogeneous medium occupying an initially hyperbolic background. Our solution is obtained by means of Green s function and the potential principle for the system with the exact boundary conditions. The Green s function expression is then given as a rational approximation to an inverse Bessel integral expression given in terms of confluent hypergeometric functions from special functions literature.
